pages.title: About Us
pages.description: Learn about Tim Hortons Menu Canada — an independent guide with verified prices, calories, allergen data and menu updates for Canadian locations.
pages.content:
Welcome to Tim Hortons Menu Canada — an independent, community-driven menu and nutrition resource built for Canadian consumers. Our mission is simple: make Tim Hortons prices, calories and hours easy to find, easy to compare, and easy to trust.

We catalog 450+ verified menu items across every category — from Double Double coffee and Iced Capps® to breakfast sandwiches, donuts, Timbits® and seasonal specials — with cup sizes and provincial pricing in mind.

What You'll Find Here

Verified PricesCanadian menu prices in CAD, checked against in-restaurant menus and updated regularly.
Calories & NutritionCalorie counts for every item and size, plus allergen and dietary notes where available.
Hours & LocationsStore, breakfast and lunch hours across Canada's 4,000+ restaurants.
Menu UpdatesNew and seasonal items — including limited-edition collections — added as they launch.

How We Verify Our Data

Prices and calories are collected from official Tim Hortons Canada sources and cross-checked with in-restaurant menus. Because individual franchises can differ slightly by province, we note where regional variation is common and aim to publish the most representative Canadian price.

This website is an independent fan resource. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Tim Hortons® or The TDL Group Corp.

Have a correction or a menu update to share? We'd love to hear from you — contact our team and help keep the guide accurate for everyone.

pages.title: Allergen & Nutritional Information
pages.description: Tim Hortons Canada allergen and nutrition guide: major allergens, cross-contact warnings and how calorie counts are calculated for menu items.
pages.content:
Tim Hortons stores prepare bakery products that contain wheat, milk, eggs, soy, peanuts, tree nuts, and sesame. Cross-contact between allergens can occur in the kitchen and prep stations.

Please inform staff of any serious allergies when ordering in-restaurant.

Major Allergens Found Across the Menu

How Calorie Counts Are Calculated

Calorie values published on this website are indicative averages based on standard Canadian serving sizes. Actual counts can vary with recipe substitutions, portion sizes and preparation methods at individual restaurants.

Every menu item on our homepage catalog lists calories next to its price — including per-size calorie counts for hot and cold drinks.

Dietary Notes

Vegetarian, vegan and other dietary preferences vary widely across the menu. For the most reliable, location-specific allergen information, consult the official Tim Hortons Canada nutrition resources or speak directly with restaurant staff before ordering.

pages.title: Tim Hortons Store & Operating Hours
pages.description: Typical Tim Hortons store hours across Canada: dine-in, drive-thru and 24/7 locations, plus links to breakfast and lunch service times.
pages.content:
Most Tim Hortons locations in Canada operate from 5:00 AM or 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM daily, with numerous high-traffic highway and urban outlets open 24/7 for drive-thru and takeout.

Standard Dine-inMon – Sun: 5:00 AM – 10:00 PM
Drive-ThruMon – Sun: 5:00 AM – 11:00 PM / 24 Hours

Service Windows at a Glance

ServiceTypical HoursNotes

Hours vary by province and individual franchise — statutory holidays often follow reduced schedules. When in doubt, check your local restaurant before visiting.

Looking for meal-specific timings? Read our dedicated guides to breakfast hours and lunch hours across Canada.

pages.title: Tim Hortons Breakfast Hours Canada
pages.description: Tim Hortons breakfast hours in Canada: when the morning menu starts and stops (5/6 AM to 11 AM), plus all-day breakfast availability and popular items.
pages.content:
Tim Hortons Canada typically serves its full traditional breakfast menu starting from store opening at 5:00 AM (or 6:00 AM Sundays) until 11:00 AM. After 11:00 AM, restaurants switch to the lunch menu, though select locations offer an all-day breakfast selection subject to local bakery availability.

Breakfast Timings:

• Monday – Saturday: 5:00 AM – 11:00 AM

• Sunday: 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM

*Hours vary by location — some restaurants begin breakfast as early as 5:00 AM daily.

Popular Breakfast Items

Morning favourites include the Bacon Breakfast Sandwich, Farmer's Breakfast Wrap, Double Stacked Breakfast Sandwich, Omelette Bites, hash browns and classic breakfast bundles for groups. Pair any of them with a Double Double, Dark Roast or steeped tea.

All-Day Breakfast: What to Know

A growing number of Canadian locations serve selected breakfast sandwiches and wraps all day. Availability depends on the restaurant format and bakery stock, so ask your local store — and note that full breakfast bundles are generally morning-only.

Browse Breakfast MenuAll Store HoursLunch Hours

pages.title: Tim Hortons Lunch Hours Canada
pages.description: Tim Hortons lunch hours in Canada: service starts at 11 AM after breakfast, with wraps, sandwiches, soups, flatbread pizzas and loaded bowls through the afternoon.
pages.content:
Lunch service officially begins immediately when the breakfast window concludes at 11:00 AM and runs through 4:00 PM, transitioning into dinner offerings. Popular lunch selections include Flatbread Pizzas, Loaded Bowls, Craveable Wraps, Soups, and Chili.

Lunch Timings:

• Daily: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

*Wraps, sandwiches, soups, and chili often remain available well after 4:00 PM until closing.

Popular Lunch Items

Midday favourites include Chicken Bacon Ranch Wraps, Crispy Chicken Craveables, Chicken Noodle Soup, Chili, Garlic Bread and the Flatbread Pizza lineup. Many of these pair with combo pricing at participating locations.

From Lunch into Dinner

After 4:00 PM, most restaurants keep their warm food counter running with sandwiches, wraps and soups until close — while breakfast items switch off at 11:00 AM sharp. For opening times, see our full store hours guide.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: Privacy policy for Tim Hortons Menu Canada: how we handle data, cookies and local storage. We do not collect personal identification information.
pages.content:
We do not collect personal identification information. Any inputs to the calorie calculator remain strictly local to your browser session.

Information We Collect

This website does not require accounts and does not ask for personal information to browse the menu. If you use the contact form or email us directly, we receive only what you choose to send, and we use it solely to respond to your message.

Cookies & Local Storage

We use minimal essential client-side storage to preserve interface states such as your active category view and meal calculator entries. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are used. See our Cookie Policy for details.

Third-Party Services

Standard hosting and content-delivery infrastructure may process technical data such as IP addresses and user-agent strings for security and performance purposes. We do not sell, rent or trade any visitor data.

Children's Privacy

This is a general-audience reference website. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. Parents who believe a child has provided us information can contact us for prompt deletion.

Policy Updates

Any changes to this policy will be published on this page with an updated revision date. Questions? Visit the contact page.

pages.title: Cookie Policy
pages.description: Cookie policy for Tim Hortons Menu Canada: how we use essential browser storage for interface state, and how you can manage or clear cookies at any time.
pages.content:
This website uses minimal essential client-side storage to preserve interface states such as your active category view and meal calculator entries.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies and local storage are small pieces of data a website can save in your browser. They help sites remember preferences between page loads and visits.

How We Use Them

TypePurposeDuration
Essential StorageRemembers calculator entries and interface preferencesSession / until cleared
AnalyticsNone currently — no advertising or tracking cookies—

Managing Cookies

You can clear or block cookies at any time through your browser settings. Because our storage is limited to essential interface state, disabling it will simply reset features like the calorie calculator between visits.

Updates to This Policy

If our use of cookies ever changes, we will update this page — see also our Privacy Policy or contact us with questions.
